notes.title: Linux Support
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35155056/418c66588dfe6798ec8defcc810589b52d2fd1ef.jpg[/img]
We glad to announce that Bunny Reversi now can be run on Linux OS.

P.S.: if you didn't know you can play with players from PC platform on Steam thanks to Steam.

Have a fun!

notes.title: Update 4
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35155056/0bf1f0a8f57482bf3c3284db0762e08ed3b591d2.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] We made SOS button more visible - so if you stuck somewhere - just press it.
[*] Now if the bot stucks in a place where he couldn't move or swim and it's his turn to play now - he will be teleported to his default location and then will go to play. Before this fix you should come to his default location to manually teleport him back - but few knew about it.
[/list]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/ZC5E7v6IPeKcJ6Zvqc/giphy.gif[/img]

notes.title: Hotfix 3.1
notes.content:
Fixed that IamBot didn't want to play with anyone. He was in deep depression.
Sorry!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35155056/17340e79b7fec15b82f52a5c0bf8cf4823a9b553.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 3
notes.content:
Fixed bug when you accept Steam invitation when you are playing with Bot, then joining your friend, the game mode didn't change to host's ones. It caused wrong achievement issues on client.

Also now after accepting invitation you will see friends name you are going to join.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35155056/951dbba2b2a85086f51c3292371b87c585bf5340.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update 2
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/XcXUIf8KS0qJmdaeY4/giphy.gif[/img]

The previous update provoke a new bug that happened when kick the bot and almost simultenously make a move + overlaping him  - actually there are couple of bugs connected with these events (thanks to @Indelacio.co.uk for the vid).

We fixed that - at least we couldn't reproduce it anymore after fix.

Also we rearrange the pause menu so you could see the menu in the  bottom above the exit

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35155056/9cc1bdf71e4280687d690f28dc2d9ea5afd89d38.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update 1
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/SqCWEhpltQvsFdpcJI/giphy.gif[/img]
[h1]General changes:[/h1]

[list]
[*]  if you kicked IamBot so he lost his mind and forgot about his turn come to him to awake. Also we added additional check when IamBot come to conscious he will try to check if it's his turn. If it doesn't help - let us know
[*]  now if it is not your turn and you are not on the gameplay field you won't hear the error sound
[*]  changed the background image for the hint line in disk customization
[/list]


[h1]Split-screen changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]  now if you press SOS then both of players will be teleported to the start location
[*]  when choosing a character  the first focus for controller will be on the Bunny Boy - not on the finished button
[*]  added on-screen hints for controls
[/list]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/RGutDuRa93jV3XZnm9/giphy.gif[/img]
